identification: Probably a John Campbell (Launceston, Tasmania, 1881-1976) drip-glaze fan-shaped wall pocket, c.1930s. Signature on back is a partly obscured incised script, consistent with Campbell but not confirmed from photos. Wall pockets are a recognised Campbell form (map, swan, koala designs recorded); this banded green/orange example looks plain.

viewing_check: Examine the incised signature on the back near the hanging hole (read 'John Campbell' / 'Tasmania', any date or number), check the rim and hanging hole for chips, hairlines and repairs, and measure it (large size and any applied or moulded decoration lift value).
